title: Other New Orleans players, pay and hours in the cabarets
summary: He names Ory, Dutrey and Dominique; pay was $35-40 a week for six-hour nights.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Always has been -- or was, yeah. Who else did you play with back then?
I don't even remember what year that was. Must have been in between the time -- between Milwaukee engagements.
Were there other New Orleans musicians that you played with about that time?
Yeah, Kid Ory, and what's the other trombone player from New Orleans?
No. I worked with him, yeah, I worked with Preston. And this was back in the twenties.
Yeah, I know who you mean. I think I know who you mean.
Yeah. Was Natty Dominique up here then?
Was most of the work in cabarets or nightclubs?
Yeah, most of it was cabarets.
$35.00, $40.00 a week, which was big money back in them days.
Six hours. Something like 10:30 to 4:30. Or 10:00 to 4:00.
Uh-huh. Did any of the bands rehearse, or did they just go --
